raw_10_honest_c3_min_5: 1. C2.4 (b) domain keyword overlap: 10-domain table is minimal subset — unknown-domain prompts default to overlap=0 which auto-fails (false negative risk for novel domains).

2. C2.4 (c) token_overlap proxy: char-set overlap ≥0.10 is naive substitute for SBERT-KO embedding sim (별도 lane). Char overlap can give false PASS when prompt+response share common Hangul chars without semantic relevance.
3. korean_coherence_score: bigram unique-ratio ≥0.5 threshold is heuristic — does not capture grammatical correctness, only diversity.
4. domain detection: trigger-keyword regex Phase 1 — capability/emotion/code triggers may misclassify if prompt mixes domain markers (e.g., '코드 기분 어때?'); Phase 2 ML classifier deferred.

5. V1 BG-FY synthesis: ko_eval_log.jsonl has no explicit per-cell V1 verdicts; we reconstructed V1 cells from raw hangul_ratio + degenerate flag — synthesis assumes V1 thresholds (≥0.30/≥0.60/non-degen) which may differ slightly from BG-FY-cycle implementation.
6. final-step-only evaluation: V2 evaluates step 10000 only (matching V1 verdict snapshot); progression across steps not analyzed in this retroeval.
7. Particle/ending counts use char-substring matching, not morphological parsing — '있다' counts both '다' (ending) and as part of '있다' which may double-count in some contexts.

8. SIMPLE_STACK_PASS_V2 verdict path requires ALL 7 cells PASS for ALL responses across both modes — much stricter than V1 step-level pass_count≥3/5; future native models will need substantially better corpus + chat-template ratio to qualify.
